config.purpose: bound optional additional API acquisition before any final aggregate is opened

primary_baselines: All four original API models are already complete at 200 episodes per game.
stop_rule: Stop starting additional optional episodes when the registered primary Qwen3.8 test acquisition completes, or at 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z, whichever occurs first. Preserve cached calls and complete saved episodes; incomplete cohorts remain unscored. A completed 200/game cohort remains eligible.
rationale: Bound extra slow API coverage while prioritizing the saved newest-family pipeline and final report. The rule depends only on acquisition completion and time, never on PnL or model ranking.

amendments.reason: Use the released second NIM slot for a catalogue-listed Gemma baseline. Include based only on availability and fixed validation quote parsing; keep the same outcome-independent cutoff and 200/game completeness rule.
